pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NON-FICTION MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we read non-fiction materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify print or electronic non- fiction materials that are interesting to read
2. read a variety of grade- appropriate non-fiction materials independently for lifelong learning

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify print or electronic non- fiction materials that are interesting to read
   In simple words: practise until you can identify print or electronic non- fiction materials that are interesting to read. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. read a variety of grade- appropriate non-fiction materials independently for lifelong learning
   In simple words: practise until you can read a variety of grade- appropriate non-fiction materials independently for lifelong learning. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials.
4. Show that you can: identify print or electronic non- fiction materials that are interesting to read

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a variety of non-fiction materials,
2. Self-efficacy: It is strengthened as the learner reads a variety of non-fiction materials to inculcate a reading culture.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify print or electronic non- fiction materials that are interesting to read
2. read a variety of grade- appropriate non-fiction materials independently for lifelong learning

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
